headline: Artificial intelligence reshaped both sides of security today—driving a vulnerability-disclosure surge that has NIST reaching for AI, a $1 billion Cyera-Oasis deal to govern AI agents, and Anthropic's move to watermark Claude—while attackers actively exploited an unpatched macOS screen-sharing flaw to plant Monero miners.

emerging_trends.text: The volume of disclosed vulnerabilities keeps climbing as researchers turn AI scanners loose on code, and NIST is now weighing whether AI can triage the flood it helped create.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI-Driven Vulnerability Surge Pushes NIST Toward AI

emerging_trends.text: Vendors increasingly frame AI agents as an identity-and-access problem, and Cyera's billion-dollar Oasis Security purchase bets that controlling what agents can touch will define the next security control plane.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Cyera Buys Oasis Security for AI Agent Control

emerging_trends.text: Public exploit code keeps compressing the window before mass attacks, as hackers began planting Monero miners on Macs within days of a macOS screen-sharing bypass going public.
emerging_trends.topic_title: macOS Screen Sharing Flaw Exploited to Deploy Monero Miner

topics.title: GitHub Dependabot Expands Malware Alerts to Eight Ecosystems
topics.latest_developments: GitHub extended Dependabot malware alerts beyond npm to seven more package registries—PyPI, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Go, crates.io, and PHP Composer.
topics.summary: Since March 2026 Dependabot flagged malicious packages only for npm, leaving developers who pulled tainted dependencies from other registries with no warning. GitHub now covers eight ecosystems, closing a wide gap in software-supply-chain defense.

sources.title: Week in review: Salesforce and ServiceNow portals exposed for 17 months, exploited Metabase 0-day

topics.title: macOS Screen Sharing Flaw Exploited to Deploy Monero Miner
topics.latest_developments: The Netherlands' National Cyber Security Centre warned that attackers, armed with newly public exploit code, are logging into Macs over Screen Sharing and installing Monero cryptocurrency miners.
topics.summary: The macOS authentication-bypass flaw lets a remote attacker log in over Screen Sharing without a password and seize full control of the machine. Mac owners should apply Apple's latest update immediately.

sources.title: Hackers exploit macOS Screen Sharing flaw to deploy Monero miner
Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation

topics.title: AI-Driven Vulnerability Surge Pushes NIST Toward AI
topics.latest_developments: Dark Reading reported that the National Institute of Standards and Technology, facing an AI-driven flood of vulnerability disclosures, is weighing AI tools to triage and process the backlog.
topics.summary: AI-augmented research and scanning are pushing vulnerability disclosures to record volumes and straining the national reporting pipeline. NIST is now asking whether AI can help it manage the surge that AI itself helped create.

sources.title: Amid AI-Driven Bug-Hunt Tsunami, NIST Looks to … AI

topics.title: Cyera Buys Oasis Security for AI Agent Control
topics.latest_developments: Cyera announced a roughly $1 billion acquisition of Oasis Security to build a unified control plane governing AI agent identities and access.
topics.summary: The deal merges data security and identity into a single control plane that governs what AI agents can access, redefining privileged access around business context. It signals that enterprises now treat autonomous agents as a first-class identity risk.

sources.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control

topics.title: Anthropic Plans to Watermark Claude's AI Text
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer detailed how Anthropic plans to embed detectable watermarks in text its Claude models generate.
topics.summary: Anthropic laid out a scheme to embed hidden signals in Claude-written text so others can identify AI-generated content. The effort aims to strengthen provenance as machine-written prose spreads across the web.

sources.title: How Anthropic plans to watermark Claude's AI-generated text

weather: Monday: Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Chance Showers And Thunderstorms, high 82F.

business_politics.title: NATO Jets Down Russian Drone Over Romania
business_politics.latest_developments: NATO fighter jets shot down a suspected Russian drone that crossed into Romanian airspace, and allied officials pinned the incursion directly on Moscow in a rare public attribution.
business_politics.summary: NATO warplanes downed a suspected Russian drone over Romania and blamed Moscow for the incursion, deepening fears that Russia's war on Ukraine could spill across the alliance's eastern frontier as Kyiv presses its own drone assault of more than 600 aircraft on Moscow.

sources.title: NATO Jets Down Suspected Russian Drone Over Romania

business.title: Pennsylvania Data-Center Fight
business.latest_developments: The battle over data-center construction across Pennsylvania grinds on while the General Assembly sits idle through its summer recess.
business.summary: Residents such as homeschooling parent Anna Clement are pressing Pennsylvania lawmakers over the noise and scale of proposed data centers, a fight that continues without state regulation as the legislature stays on break, even as the industry courts the commonwealth's cheap power.

sources.title: Noisy data center debate goes on while lawmakers on summer break

business.title: Pitt Targets Aggressive Childhood Cancer
business.latest_developments: University of Pittsburgh researchers reported progress against an aggressive cancer most often diagnosed in infants, testing a new combination of two treatments.
business.summary: University of Pittsburgh researchers are pairing two therapies to attack an aggressive cancer diagnosed mostly in infants, an approach they say could also work against other tumors and adds to the region's research-economy pipeline.

sources.title: Pitt researchers combine therapies to target aggressive childhood cancer

around_town.title: Turnpike Safety Changes After Tunnel Fire
around_town.latest_developments: The Pennsylvania Turnpike is adopting new safety measures after a fire inside the Allegheny Mountain Tunnel.
around_town.summary: The Pennsylvania Turnpike is making safety changes following a fire in the Allegheny Mountain Tunnel, one of the toll road's mountain tunnels in the Allegheny highlands that carry traffic between the Pittsburgh region and central Pennsylvania.

sources.title: After Allegheny Mountain Tunnel fire, Pennsylvania Turnpike makes safety changes

around_town.title: Butler County Special Election
around_town.latest_developments: A special election to fill Pennsylvania's 12th state House district in Butler County shapes up as an early read on the 2026 midterms.
around_town.summary: A special election for the 12th state House district seat in Butler County is drawing outsized attention as a bellwether that could forecast how November's midterm elections break across Pennsylvania.

sources.title: How a Butler County special election could help forecast the midterms in Pennsylvania

around_teams.title: Pirates Push Back Skenes' Start
around_teams.latest_developments: The Pirates moved ace Paul Skenes' next start from Sunday to Wednesday to give the All-Star extra rest.
around_teams.summary: Manager Don Kelly pushed Paul Skenes' scheduled start against the Boston Red Sox back three days to Wednesday for added rest; Skenes said he doesn't necessarily disagree with the call amid the Pirates' second-half slide.

sources.title: Pirates push Paul Skenes' scheduled start back from Sunday to Wednesday. 'I don't necessarily disagree,' he says

around_teams.title: Benton's Five-Year Extension
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers set defensive tackle Keeanu Benton's new deal at five years and $73.75 million, and Benton spoke at Saturday's training camp.
around_teams.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers locked up defensive tackle Keeanu Benton, the Wisconsin product from general manager Omar Khan's first draft class, on a five-year, $73.75 million extension, cementing him as a defensive-line cornerstone.

sources.title: Steelers agree on a new 5-year, $73.75 million deal with Keeanu Benton

team_usa.title: Ledecky's First 800m International Loss
team_usa.latest_developments: Lani Pallister of Australia ran down Katie Ledecky to win the 800-meter freestyle at the Pan Pacific Championships, the first time an international rival beat Ledecky in the event.
team_usa.summary: Australia's Lani Pallister edged Katie Ledecky in the 800-meter freestyle at the Pan Pacific Championships, handing the American her first international loss in a race she has owned; Pallister had already beaten Ledecky in the 400 free a day earlier.

sources.title: Pallister stuns Ledecky with first int'l 800m loss

team_usa.title: Douglass Lowers 50 Free World Record Again
team_usa.latest_developments: Kate Douglass broke the women's 50-meter freestyle world record a second time in one day, winning the Pan Pacific final in 23.19 seconds.
team_usa.summary: Kate Douglass lowered her own 50-meter freestyle world record twice on Saturday at the Pan Pacific Championships, capping the day by winning the final in 23.19 seconds.

sources.title: Douglass sets second WR of day in 50-meter free

reading.author: Stratechery
reading.title: Anthropic's Watermarking, How It (Probably) Works, Worse Than It Seems
reading.summary: Ben Thompson argues Anthropic's move to watermark AI output, adopted to satisfy the E.U.'s AI law, is a bad idea on philosophical grounds and would work worse in practice than it appears.

reading.author: Ed Zitron
reading.title: Premium: How Much Money Does AI Need?
reading.summary: Zitron tallies the enormous capital the AI industry keeps demanding and argues the sums have swelled far beyond what current revenue can justify.

reading.author: Cal Newport
reading.title: On AI Coding and Its Discontents
reading.summary: Newport uses a converted AI skeptic's account from Silicon Valley to weigh how much AI coding tools actually change the day-to-day work of software engineering.
